description: List all blog authors for the active brand. Returns id+name+isBrandDefault by default (short); use detail='medium' for email/social links and the publications that default to the author (defaultForPublicationIds). Author IDs can be passed to generate_blog_post, seo_write_article or update_blog_article; change defaults with set_default_blog_author.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: list_blog_authors
